acquisition_method.evidence: Eluting peptides were analyzed in the mass spectrometer using data independent acquisition (DIA) mode.

cleavage_agent.evidence: For experiments in Figs. 3 and 7d-e a protein amount of 10 µg was digested (trypsin) using an AssayMAP Bravo liquid handling system (Agilent technologies) running the autoSP3 protocol according to Müller et al.

collision_energy.evidence: Scans were recorded at 30 k resolution (1,000% AGC target, 54 ms maxIT) and a fragmentation energy of 28%.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The analytical multistep gradient (300 nl/min) was performed using a nanoEase MZ Peptide analytical column (300Å, 1.7 μm, 75 μm x 200 mm, Waters) using solvent A (0.1% formic acid in water) and solvent B (0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile).
